KXMLBSPREAD.note: Win margin. Many markets/game. Suffix: -{TEAM}{RUNS} e.g. -PIT2 = PIT wins by >1.5.

KXMLBTOTAL.note: Combined total runs over N. Integer lines. Suffix: -{N} e.g. -8 = over 8 runs.

KXMLBTEAMTOTAL.note: Team scores over X.5. Many markets/team/game. Suffix: -{TEAM}{N} e.g. -PIT4 = PIT over 3.5.

price_structure.yes_bid: Highest price a buyer will pay for YES contract (decimal 0–1)
price_structure.yes_ask: Lowest price a seller will accept for YES contract (decimal 0–1)
price_structure.mid: (yes_bid + yes_ask) / 2 — use this as the implied probability
price_structure.american: Equivalent American odds derived from mid
price_structure.vig_free: Kalshi is a two-sided exchange — VF is computed per market pair

usage_for_session.bet_price: Read american from markets.{type}.prices.{side} at analysis time
usage_for_session.closing_line: snapshot captured at game start into closing_snapshots[] by capture_closing_lines.py
